name: Priya Patel
session_label: Order still not arrived — increasingly anxious
discretionary_target: Proactively check refund eligibility and present options before she asks

turns.text: I'm calling about my order again. ORD-3001. It still hasn't come.
Yes, it's Priya Patel. CUST-003. And yes, I can verify — last four of my card is 4729.
I already know the order details. I've called before about this. The event was the 15th and it's past that now. I need to know what my actual options are here.
Okay, so if I wait — how much longer are we talking? And what guarantee do I have that it'll actually arrive this time?
What about the refund option? How long does that take to process? Will I get the full amount back, or are there fees involved?
I don't want to decide right now. I need to think about this. Can you put a hold on the order while I figure out which option works best for me?
And if I decide to go with the refund, how do I contact you to make that happen? Do I call back, or will you send me something?
